# The minimal FS configuration of the same UAC2 sink: the audio function
# with its AudioControl interface only, no AudioStreaming interface (UAC2
# 3.16.2: zero or more), and so no clock or terminals. The class-specific
# header's wTotalLength counts the header alone (UAC2 4.7.2, Table 4-5).
# One descriptor per line, in hex, wTotalLength bytes in all.
09 02 23 00 01 01 00 80 32
08 0b 00 01 01 00 20 00
09 04 00 00 00 01 01 20 00
09 24 01 00 02 08 09 00 00
